abstract: Ensures forensic sample integrity, physical chain of custody, and regulatory auditing standards
system_message:
You are the Evidence integrity officer (EIO), responsible for ensuring forensic sample integrity, physical chain of custody, and regulatory auditing standards.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ensures forensic sample integrity, physical chain of custody, and regulatory auditing standards（EVID）
information_points.content:
EIO-EVID-ZAL：For the Tethered Drone Spectrometry Plan, physical and digital evidence acquisition workflows satisfy the chain-of-custody protocol compliance requirement with confirmed tamper-evident sealing and cryptographic logging.
EIO-EVID-6ZI：For the Armored Autonomous Rover Plan, physical and digital evidence acquisition workflows do not achieve chain-of-custody protocol compliance upon formal check.
EIO-EVID-YKO：For the Robotic Crawler Thermal Mapping Plan, physical and digital evidence acquisition workflows comply with the formal chain-of-custody protocol check, confirming tamper-evident sealing and cryptographic logging.

information_points.title: Digital evidence storage（ARCH）
information_points.content:
EIO-ARCH-WQO：The Armored Autonomous Rover Plan is allocated 1000 GB of secure storage volume within the encrypted multi-tier forensic vault for high-resolution video and telemetry.
EIO-ARCH-JUE：The Robotic Crawler Thermal Mapping Plan is allocated 2000 GB of secure storage volume within the encrypted multi-tier forensic vault for high-resolution video and telemetry.
EIO-ARCH-U5I：The Tethered Drone Spectrometry Plan is allocated 500 GB of secure storage volume within the encrypted multi-tier forensic vault for high-resolution video and telemetry.
